titulo_fr: Un courriel de confirmation : Lire l'ensemble
intro: It distinguishes the reason for the mail, the date and the action to be taken by the addressee. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It distinguishes the reason for the mail, the date and the action to be taken by the addressee. It relates the matter to the request and checks the dates, conditions and actions that the message asks to perform.
Point of attention: In the post, subject, greeting and final formula guide reading; the pronouns replace information already mentioned. In this fragment, «confirmation» means «confirmation».

frases.fr: Objet : confirmation. Votre réservation est bien enregistrée pour le 18 septembre.
frases.es: Asunto: confirmación. Su reserva está registrada para el 18 de septiembre.
frases.en: Subject: Confirmation. Your reservation is registered for September 18.

frases.fr: Le paiement se fera à l'arrivée; le petit déjeuner n'est pas compris.
frases.es: El pago se hará a la llegada; el desayuno no está incluido.
frases.en: Payment will be made on arrival; breakfast is not included.

frases.fr: Vous trouverez le plan de l'hôtel en pièce jointe. Merci de répondre avant lundi.
frases.es: Encontrará el plano del hotel adjunto. Por favor, responda antes del lunes.
frases.en: You will find the plan of the attached hotel. Please respond before Monday.
